findings.title: The notes leave out what an owner checks first, so the trial button asks them to act on trust

location.description: the first of the three notes under the hero, 'Works with your till'

findings.viewer_experience: An owner reads 'Works with your till' and 'Orders from your distributor' and cannot tell if their own till, card reader or distributor is supported, or who handles returns.

current.value: The notes name no till, card reader or distributor, do not say who tracks returns, and give no comparison with how the owner works now.

findings.target: The notes state which tills and card readers work, which distributors get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and give one comparison with how the owner works now. The maker must supply these facts.
findings.fix_direction: The maker supplies the supported tills and card readers, the distributors that get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and one comparison with how the owner works now. Then edit 'Returns are tracked for you' so it says who tracks them. Do not invent these facts.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports, the three notes name what the owner checks first (tills and card readers, distributors, who tracks returns) and give one comparison with the owner's current way of working, with facts from the maker.

findings.title: Note 2 ends with 'takes.' alone on its third line

location.description: the second note under the hero, whose third line is one word

findings.viewer_experience: The single word leaves a ragged gap under the second column, which is now the only one of the three that runs three lines.

current.value: 3 lines, last line is one word

findings.target: Note 2 does not end on a single word alone on its last line.
findings.fix_direction: Change the width of that column a little, or edit the note so it ends on two full lines.

closed_when.check: In the desktop and widescreen viewports, note 2 (section.facts > p:nth-of-type(2)) has no line with one word alone at its end.

findings.title: Note 1 runs 44 characters per line, against the 45 asked for

location.description: the first note under the hero

findings.viewer_experience: Note 1 is one character per line under the 45 the check asks for; note 2 is at 46.
findings.target: characters per line of 45 or more for notes 1 and 2 together. Only if the maker wants the number met.
findings.fix_direction: Changing the gap more will not fix note 1 and note 2 together: the gap change put note 2 over 45 but left note 1 at 44. Only make the change if the maker wants the number met.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of section.facts > p:nth-of-type(1) and p:nth-of-type(2) in the desktop and widescreen viewports is 45 or more
